_about: Placeholder party and starting bag for the test room. HP and Juice are not here on purpose: GameState works them out once from the growth table (data/party/growth.csv) plus the starting gear (StatCalc.sync_maximums), so Status, Equip and battles agree. Real stats come from characters.json later (task M2). Each member's equipment is what they wear on a new game (copied from items/equipment.json starting_gear; Equipment falls back to that file when a member has none).
